name: MILU
intro: MILU 是 Claude 系统卡中使用的印度语言多任务理解评测，用于衡量模型在多种 Indic 语言上的知识与理解能力。
org: AI4Bharat, IIT Madras, IBM Research India
build_method: 考试题收集, 清洗, 翻译补齐, 人工检查
eval_feature: Indic语言, 多学科知识, 印度文化知识
build_method_en: Exam-question collection, cleaning, translation gap filling, manual checks
eval_feature_en: Indic languages, multi-subject knowledge, India-centric cultural knowledge
intro_en: MILU is a Multi-task Indic Language Understanding benchmark used in Claude system cards to measure knowledge and understanding across Indic languages.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Scrape more than 150K questions from over 40 national, state, and regional exam types"] --> B["Remove reading-comprehension, image-based, over-four-option, wrong-language, and duplicate items"]
    B --> C["Recover missing topics via IndicTrans2-to-English and GPT-4o-mini labels"]
    C --> D["Cluster labels and manually merge them into 41 subjects and eight domains"]
    D --> E["Fill subject-language pairs below 100 by translating same-subject English items with GPT-4o"]
    E --> F["Manually audit every language and release 79,617 test plus 8,933 validation questions"]
    F --> G["Evaluate models in zero-, one-, and five-shot multiple-choice settings"]
    G --> H["Report accuracy by language, subject, domain, and resource level"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从40多类国家级、邦级与区域级考试抓取超过15万道问题"] --> B["去除阅读理解、图像题、超过四选项、语言错误与重复问题"]
    B --> C["用IndicTrans2译成英文并由GPT-4o-mini恢复缺失主题标签"]
    C --> D["聚类标签并人工合并为41个学科与八大领域"]
    D --> E["对少于100题的学科-语言组合用GPT-4o翻译同科英文题补齐"]
    E --> F["逐语言人工审计并发布79,617道测试题与8,933道验证题"]
    F --> G["在零样本、一样本与五样本多选设置下评估模型"]
    G --> H["按语言、学科、领域与资源等级报告准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.02538 / NAACL 2025, Sections 3.1-3.3 and 5. The diagrams preserve collection from more than 40 exam types and over 150K raw questions, exact format/language/dedup filters, IndicTrans2 only for translating untagged questions to English before GPT-4o-mini topic labeling, NV-Embed-v2 plus K-means and manual consolidation into 41 subjects/eight domains, GPT-4o gap filling to at least 100 items per subject-language pair, final per-language audit, exact 79,617 test and 8,933 validation sizes, and zero-/one-/five-shot accuracy. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.
